theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_campanato
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (r s₀ A α : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < s₀ → 0 ≤ A → 0 < α → ContinuousOn g (closedBall 0 (r + s₀)) → (∀ᵐ z ∂(volume.restrict (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)), ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z (s / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (g x - g z)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A * s ^ ((n : ℝ) + 2 * α))) → ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ∀ y ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ‖x - y‖ ≤ s₀ / 2 → hsNorm (g x - g y) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 ^ (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2 + 2 * α) * A / unitBallVolume n) * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
